description.zh: 一个比你聪明的系统如果追求错误的目标，那它越聪明，你就越危险。AI教科书的作者罗素教授将带你直面这个时代最紧迫的问题：如何确保AI系统的行为符合人类价值观？RLHF是否足够？幻觉能否被消除？当AI变得越来越强大，我们是否还能保持控制？
description.en: A system smarter than you pursuing the wrong objective — the smarter it is, the more dangerous you are. Prof. Russell — author of the AI textbook — will guide you to confront this era's most urgent question: how do we ensure AI systems behave in accordance with human values? Is RLHF sufficient? Can hallucination be eliminated? As AI grows ever more powerful, can we still maintain control?

description.zh: 理解对齐问题的本质——为什么指定正确的目标如此困难
description.en: Understand the essence of the alignment problem — why specifying correct objectives is so difficult

description.zh: 掌握RLHF的原理、流程和局限性
description.en: Master the principles, process, and limitations of RLHF

description.zh: 理解AI安全与伦理的核心困境：偏见、公平、自主性
description.en: Understand core dilemmas of AI safety and ethics: bias, fairness, autonomy

description.zh: 思考控制问题——当AI超越人类能力时如何保持安全
description.en: Consider the control problem — maintaining safety as AI surpasses human capabilities
